$comment: Canonical design tokens for secure-p2p-chat. Source of record for brand color + per-theme values shared conceptually across desktop (React/CSS custom properties), egui (client/src/gui/styling.rs), and the TUI's brand-neutral chrome accent. Not consumed by a build step (see docs/05_platform_spec.md §10) — kept in sync manually, with client/tests/theme_tokens_test.rs asserting egui's Visuals match these values so drift fails a test instead of going unnoticed.
